package usecase

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type passedEvidenceWire struct {
	Schema                  string                 `json:"schema"`
	EvidenceID              string                 `json:"evidence_id"`
	LearningActionID        string                 `json:"learning_action_id"`
	LearningPathItemID      string                 `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID           string                 `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	StudentID               string                 `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID          string                 `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID          string                 `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest      string                 `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	WorkspaceDigest         string                 `json:"workspace_digest"`
	SubmissionID            string                 `json:"submission_id"`
	Outcome                 string                 `json:"outcome"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string                 `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
	HintsUsed               int                    `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int                   `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                   `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
	Evidence                []ports.TargetEvidence `json:"evidence"`
	OccurredAt              time.Time              `json:"occurred_at"`
	PolicyVersion           string                 `json:"policy_version"`
}

// EvidenceDeliveryFailure contains only immutable identity and a fixed safe code.
type EvidenceDeliveryFailure struct {
	MessageID string
	Code      string
}

type EvidenceDispatchError struct{ Failures []EvidenceDeliveryFailure }

func (err *EvidenceDispatchError) Error() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("evidence delivery failed for %d message(s)", len(err.Failures))
}
func (err *EvidenceDispatchError) Unwrap() error { return domain.ErrDependency }

func (runtime *Runtime) DispatchEvidence(ctx context.Context, limit int) (int, error) {
	if limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return 0, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	messages, err := runtime.Repository.PendingEvidence(ctx, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	delivered := 0
	failures := &EvidenceDispatchError{}
	failedStudents := map[string]bool{}
	for _, message := range messages {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return delivered, errors.Join(dispatchFailure(failures), err)
		}
		// Repository supplies only heads. Keep causality even for an alternate port
		// implementation returning more than one message for a student.
		if failedStudents[message.StudentID] {
			continue
		}
		passed, decodeErr := DecodePassedEvidence(message.Payload)
		code := ""
		if decodeErr != nil {
			code = ports.EvidenceFailurePayloadInvalid
		} else if message.SubmissionID != passed.SubmissionID || message.ID != passed.EvidenceID ||
			!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(message.StudentID) || message.StudentID != passed.StudentID {
			code = ports.EvidenceFailureIdentityMismatch
		} else {
			receipt, providerErr := runtime.Evidence.ApplyPassedEvidence(ctx, passed)
			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
				return delivered, errors.Join(dispatchFailure(failures), err)
			}
			if providerErr != nil {
				code = ports.EvidenceFailureProviderUnavailable
			} else if receipt.Schema != "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2" || !receipt.Accepted || receipt.EvidenceID != passed.EvidenceID ||
				receipt.LearningActionID != passed.LearningActionID || receipt.PolicyVersion != StudentReceiptPolicyV1 {
				code = ports.EvidenceFailureReceiptMismatch
			} else if markerErr := runtime.Repository.MarkEvidenceDelivered(ctx, message.ID, runtime.now()); markerErr != nil {
				code = ports.EvidenceFailureDeliveryMarker
			}
		}
		if code == "" {
			delivered++
		}
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return delivered, errors.Join(dispatchFailure(failures), err)
		}
		if code != "" {
			failures.Failures = append(failures.Failures, EvidenceDeliveryFailure{MessageID: message.ID, Code: code})
			if err := runtime.Repository.MarkEvidenceFailed(ctx, message.ID, runtime.now(), code); err != nil {
				return delivered, errors.Join(failures, fmt.Errorf("persist evidence delivery failure: %w", err))
			}
			failedStudents[message.StudentID] = true
			continue
		}
	}
	return delivered, dispatchFailure(failures)
}

func dispatchFailure(failures *EvidenceDispatchError) error {
	if len(failures.Failures) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return failures
}

func DecodePassedEvidence(raw json.RawMessage) (ports.PassedEvidence, error) {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var wire passedEvidenceWire
	if err := decoder.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
		return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if wire.Schema != EvidenceSchemaV2 || wire.PolicyVersion != EvidencePolicyV2 || wire.Outcome != "passed" || !domain.ValidRequirementCorrelation(wire.LearningPathItemID, wire.RequirementID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(wire.EvidenceID) || wire.EvidenceID != wire.SubmissionID || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(wire.LearningActionID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(wire.StudentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(wire.TaskInstanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(wire.TaskRevisionID) ||
		!validEvidenceDigest(wire.TaskRevisionDigest) || !validEvidenceDigest(wire.WorkspaceDigest) || wire.AssistancePolicyVersion == "" ||
		wire.HintsUsed < 0 || wire.HintsUsed > 1000 || wire.OccurredAt.IsZero() || len(wire.Evidence) == 0 || len(wire.Evidence) > 100 {
		return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if (wire.HintsUsed == 0) != (wire.MaxHintLevel == nil) || wire.MaxHintLevel != nil && (*wire.MaxHintLevel < 1 || *wire.MaxHintLevel > 7) {
		return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	seenTargets, seenSteps := map[string]struct{}{}, map[string]struct{}{}
	targets := make([]domain.Target, 0, len(wire.Evidence))
	steps := make([]string, 0)
	for _, item := range wire.Evidence {
		if (item.Target.Type != "concept" && item.Target.Type != "capability") || item.Target.Key == "" || item.Target.Version == "" ||
			item.Correctness < 0 || item.Correctness > 1 || item.Independence < 0 || item.Independence > 1 || item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 ||
			len(item.StepIDs) == 0 || len(item.StepIDs) > 100 {
			return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
		}
		identity := item.Target.Type + "\x00" + item.Target.Key + "\x00" + item.Target.Version
		if _, duplicate := seenTargets[identity]; duplicate {
			return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
		}
		seenTargets[identity] = struct{}{}
		targets = append(targets, item.Target)
		perTargetSteps := map[string]struct{}{}
		for _, stepID := range item.StepIDs {
			if strings.TrimSpace(stepID) != stepID || stepID == "" {
				return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
			}
			if _, duplicate := perTargetSteps[stepID]; duplicate {
				return ports.PassedEvidence{}, domain.ErrInvalid
			}
			perTargetSteps[stepID] = struct{}{}
			if _, exists := seenSteps[stepID]; !exists {
				seenSteps[stepID] = struct{}{}
				steps = append(steps, stepID)
			}
		}
	}
	return ports.PassedEvidence{EvidenceID: wire.EvidenceID, LearningActionID: wire.LearningActionID,
		LearningPathItemID: wire.LearningPathItemID, RequirementID: wire.RequirementID, StudentID: wire.StudentID, TaskInstanceID: wire.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: wire.TaskRevisionID,
		TaskRevisionDigest: wire.TaskRevisionDigest, WorkspaceDigest: wire.WorkspaceDigest, SubmissionID: wire.SubmissionID,
		Targets: targets, Steps: steps, HintsUsed: wire.HintsUsed, MaxHintLevel: wire.MaxHintLevel,
		TeacherAssistanceUsed: wire.TeacherAssistanceUsed, AssistancePolicyVersion: wire.AssistancePolicyVersion,
		Evidence: wire.Evidence, OccurredAt: wire.OccurredAt.UTC()}, nil
}

func validEvidenceDigest(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") || len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 {
		return false
	}
	digest, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"))
	return err == nil && len(digest) == 32
}
